title: Sandrine W NDE 6932
content: I went to the toilet due to violent abdominal pain. I had a bad diarrhea, felt really badly, and my head was turning. After giving birth to two children without epidural, I can say that the pain was much worse than delivery contractions. After I emptied myself, I got up from the toilet and wanted go out of the room, to call my partner of that time, to help me. It was absolutely important that he would bring me to the hospital and call my parents. I had the impression that the pain would kill me. I got up and BOOM, I fell and immediately the pain disappeared. Then I sat up and then stood up, except that my body was still lying lifeless on the floor between the toilet and the corridor. I felt good and had no pain anymore. At the time, my friend was living in a charming little apartment. The kitchen was at one side of the corridor (approximately 10 meters/ 30 feet) and the living room at the other end, and in between the toilet and the bedroom, all with a wooden floor. I saw myself on the floor. At the beginning, this was super experience. I went to the kitchen, I saw the dishes waiting to be cleaned, I rounded the table and looked through the window, and the apartment gave view to the courtyards. I don't know how long of a time this took. I listened to the neighbors, saw them walking through the courtyard, then I lifted my head and saw the pearl grey sky coming through, between the buildings and there I felt that I could leave, mounting in the sky and I started to panic. I turned, and went around the table again. I ran into the corridor, hopping over my body, came into the living room, my partner was standing near the window. He was smoking a cigarette, I was shaking him, but he wasn't seeing nor hearing nor feeling me. Then I returned to my still lifeless body and at this moment, I heard steps that made the wooden floor creak: it was my friend. When he saw my body, he rushed to my body ignoring me (my spirit that I could visualize as myself without a body, in fact there were two me's!) He knelt down and started to shake me and there, my bodiless me, dove back into my body and then the pain came back!!! He brought me to the hospital, my mother arrived at this moment and I didn't say anything to anybody. The doctors concluded it was a blackout because of my abdominal pains which were caused by a bowel disorder.

environment.environment_other_detail: Observed the apartment (kitchen, corridor, living room), courtyard with neighbors walking, and a 'pearl grey sky' between buildings.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt the 'bodiless me' 'dove back' into the body when her partner found and shook her physical body.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe abdominal pain with diarrhea; doctors said blackout due to abdominal pains caused by a bowel disorder.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Panic at the sense she 'could leave, mounting in the sky'; inability to be seen/heard by partner; return triggered when partner found and shook body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in the apartment with observations and attempted interaction; no tunnel/light/life review; return occurred when partner discovered her body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experienced a classic veridical-style OBE in a familiar setting, described as 'two me's' (bodiless self and physical body). Panic arose when she felt she could 'leave, mounting in the sky,' but she did not describe entering another realm.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "my body was still lying lifeless on the floor"; "my spirit that I could visualize as myself without a body, in fact there were two me's!"; "my bodiless me, dove back into my body and then the pain came back!!!"
